'''Odd Olai Aalen''' (born 6 May 1947, in [[Oslo]])<ref name=nbl/> is a Norwegian [[statistician]] in the Department of Biostatistics at the Institute of Basic Medical Sciences at the [[University of Oslo]],<ref>{{cite web|title=Odd Aalen Olai|url=http://www.uio.no/?vrtx=person-view&uid=oaalen|work=Universitetet i Oslo|accessdate=3 January 2011}}</ref> where he is a [[professor emeritus]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.med.uio.no/imb/english/research/centres/ocbe/people/|title=People|publisher=Institute of Basic Medical Sciences, University of Oslo|accessdate=12 March 2025}}</ref> He is the namesake of the [[Nelson–Aalen estimator]] and Aalen-Johansen estimator, used in [[survival analysis]],<ref>{{cite book|title=Applied Survival Analysis: Regression Modeling of Time-to-Event Data|series=Wiley Series in Probability and Statistics|first1=David W. Jr.|last1=Hosmer|first2=Stanley|last2=Lemeshow|first3=Susanne|last3=May|edition=2nd|publisher=John Wiley & Sons|year=2011|isbn=9781118211588|contribution=2.5 Other functions of survival time and their estimators|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=IvvOopIqzWsC}}</ref> [[reliability engineering]],<ref>{{cite book|title=Introduction to Quality and Reliability Engineering|series=Springer Series in Reliability Engineering|first=Renyan|last=Jiang|publisher=Springer|year=2015|isbn=9783662472156|page=75|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=y2d1CQAAQBAJ&pg=PA75}}</ref> and [[life insurance]]<ref>{{cite book|title=Statistical Models Based on Counting Processes|series=Springer Series in Statistics|first1=Per K.|last1=Andersen|first2=Ornulf|last2=Borgan|first3=Richard D.|last3=Gill|first4=Niels|last4=Keiding|publisher=Springer|year=2012|isbn=9781461243489|page=311|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=fh3SBwAAQBAJ&pg=PA311}}</ref> to estimate the cumulative number of expected events.

==Life==
Aalen completed his [[examen artium]] in 1966 at [[Oslo Cathedral School]] before studying first mathematics and physics and then statistics in which he graduated at the [[University of Oslo]] in 1972.<ref name=nbl>{{cite web | last =Borgan | first =Ørnulf | title =Odd Aalen | work =Norsk biografisk leksikon | publisher = Store norske leksikon | date =13 February 2009 | url =http://nbl.snl.no/Odd_Aalen | accessdate =30 April 2014 | language =Norwegian }}</ref> He completed a Ph.D. in 1995 at the [[University of California, Berkeley]], with the dissertation ''Statistical Inference for a Family of Counting Processes'' supervised by [[Lucien Le Cam]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|34526}}</ref>

==Honors and awards==
Aalen is an elected member of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://dnva.no/medlemmer/15|title=Medlemmer|publisher=Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters|access-date=2024-05-18}}</ref> He was elected as a [[Fellow of the American Statistical Association]] in 2007.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://ww2.amstat.org/fellows/|title=ASA Fellows|publisher=American Statistical Association|access-date=12 March 2025}}</ref>
